client.business_model: Specialty defense contractor that designs and manufactures high-fidelity training/simulation systems and advanced portable power solutions through multiple U.S. and Israeli facilities.
client.sponsor_pe_firm: Albion River (acquired January 2025; previously owned by Greenbriar Equity Group 2019-2025)
client.client_history: Founded in 1990 and incorporated in Delaware, Arotech grew into a niche defense supplier with two main divisions—Training & Simulation and Power Systems—serving military and law-enforcement markets worldwide. It was a NASDAQ-listed public company until December 2019, when Greenbriar Equity Group took it private, and was subsequently acquired by Albion River in 2025.

revenue.source: Wikipedia article citing FY-2018 10-K; Zippia company revenue page (both report $96.6 M for 2018)
revenue.notes: Last publicly reported revenue before going private; no financials released post-2019.

locations.source: Arotech 2018 Annual Report (Ann Arbor MI HQ; Hanahan SC; Oviedo FL; Beit Shemesh & Dimona, Israel)
locations.notes: Report lists these five principal facilities; current site count could differ but no newer official data available.

employees.source: Wikipedia (citing FY-2018 10-K) and Investing.com profile – both list 472 employees for 2018
employees.notes: Employee figure consistently reported for 2017-2018; a 2025 Equilar snapshot gives 500-1,000, but without detail. Using last precise public figure.
